description: Cartograma - Polígono das Secas - Estado da Bahia - :.500.000 - Raster - - SEI is a series of datasets listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). Cartograma do Polígono das Secas do Estado da Bahia, na escala 1:6.500.000, ano de 2023, de autoria da Superintendência de Estudos Econômicos e Sociais da Bahia - SEI, elaborado pela Diretoria de Informações Geoambientais - DIGEO. Coverage: Brasil. The portal lists 3 near-identical datasets in this series (one per year, month, area or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. Its tags are Semi-árido, Clima, Seca, Caatinga, climatologyMeteorologyAtmosphere. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
